newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Jubilee says drilling lifts Kathleen Valley.
newsitem.headline: Jubilee says drilling lifts Kathleen Valley.

text.p: Western Australian miner Jubilee Gold Mines NL said on Tuesday that drilling in the south-east of its Kathleen Valley project has indicated the possibility of further nickel sulphides.

Jubilee said results from a 97-hole rotary air blast drill programme included 10 metres of 0.86 percent nickel, 0.11 percent cobalt and 400 parts per million (ppm) of copper from 16 metres, and 24 metres of 0.86 percent nickel, 0.12 percent cobalt and 1,085 ppm of copper from 12 metres.
"The results are significant in that the combination and high levels of metals indicate a strong possibility of nickel sulphides in fresh rock below this layer," the company said.
Jubilee said the discovery added to the nickel potential at the Kathleen Valley project near Leinster.
Jubilee's share price rose briefly in early trade to A$0.24 before settling back to A$0.215, steady with Monday's close.
